_comment: Floor-wide PAPER risk limits. Every bot entry must pass these (ultron/risk.py). Edit and the live floor picks changes up within a minute.

risk_per_trade._comment: risk per trade (% of current paper equity) = allocator weight x 10, clamped to 0.25%..1%

_comment_dd: floor-wide kill: if paper equity (incl. open P&L) falls this % below its closed-trade peak, all new entries stop and open trades are closed. Resume by setting equity_reset_ts (unix s) or raising the limit.
